newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil civil service panel vote seen taking 2 wks.
newsitem.headline: Brazil civil service panel vote seen taking 2 wks.

text.p: Voting on Brazil's civil service reform by a lower house committee, which is due to begin on Wednesday, is expected to take until the end of October, the leader of a government-allied political party said.

The committee will have to vote not only on the merits of the text of the constitutional amendment itself, but also on 23 proposed amendments, said Inocencio Oliveira, lower house leader of the Liberal Front Party (PFL).
